notes.title: Happy Holidays Explorers!
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/5b32b809c18fb587ff28d73d15a35c84b57f9fda.png[/img][/url]
[h2]Ho, ho, ho, Explorers! 🎄[/h2]

[b]The holidays are here, and from everyone at Total Mayhem Games, we wish you happy holidays and all the best for 2025![/b] It’s been quite the year! Maybe a quiet one on the surface, but trust us, behind the scenes at our Rotterdam base camp, it’s been anything but. We’ve been hard at work preparing for the adventures to come, and we’re thrilled to head into the new year with all of you by our side.

But what’s a holiday season without a little something to unwrap? 🎁 We’re kicking things off with a [b]6-day advent calendar[/b] (in full We Were Here style, of course)!

[h2]🎶 Day 1: Cozy Lo-Fi Tunes for Every Explorer[/h2]

We’re starting things off with a musical treat! If you’ve seen the [url=https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o][b]YouTube video[/b][/url] featuring remixes of the original We Were Here soundtracks in lo-fi style, you already know the vibe. As of today, you can also find them on [url=https://open.spotify.com/album/6JOpn6nak2HJCajID9w2Lu?si=mCSsCCMlSP2eSkMVZYnfFw][b]Spotify[/b][/url]. Whether you’re studying, commuting, or just relaxing by the fire, these tunes will bring some Antarctic calm to your day. 🎧

[previewyoutube=UFM6xBz_18o;full]https://youtu.be/UFM6xBz_18o[/previewyoutube]

[h2]✨ What’s Next? Stay Tuned![/h2]

[b]Over the next five days, we’ll be revealing a new surprise each day.[/b] A little spoiler? Some seriously cool merch featuring brand-new artwork has just dropped. If you can’t wait, you can sneak a peek [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/]here[/url]. Otherwise, [b]keep an eye on our [url=https://linktr.ee/WeWereHereSeries]socials[/url] and let the surprises unfold!
[/b]
[h2]Christmas at Base Camp 🎅[/h2]

For those craving a festive co-op adventure, [b]we’ve brought back the holiday-themed puzzle at base camp in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900]We Were Here Together![/url][/b] Grab your favorite Explorer, whip up some hot cocoa, and dive in for some wintry fun.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27599300/251f64f8d7d8919519f6b3afc6f315df9e2beed3.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Winter Sale Alert![/h2]

Oh, and don’t forget: the Steam Winter Sale is live now, and the [b]We Were Here games are available with some sweet discounts.[/b] If there’s a game missing from your collection (or you want to gift one to a friend), now’s the perfect time to grab it. Check out the deals:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/677160/We_Were_Here_Too/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/?curator_clanid=33033900

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2296990/We_Were_Here_Expeditions_The_FriendShip/?curator_clanid=33033900

[h3]Stay warm, stay adventurous, and enjoy the holidays!
— The Total Mayhem Games Team
[/h3]

tags.feature: - A new game mode has been added to matchmaking and offline play: Deathmatch.

notes.title: Explore We Were Here Forever Like Never Before
notes.content:
[h2]Attention Explorers![/h2]

The Festive Season is here, so it is time to cozy up on the couch and play some of your favorite games with friends and family. And because it is the season of giving, we would like to gift all the fans of our franchise a huge brand-new patch for [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]. This patch is our heartfelt tribute to both the weathered Explorers already familiar with the puzzles and riddles of Castle Rock, and the fresh faces on the verge of escaping Castle Rock for the first time. We are committed to delivering the finest experience possible to all Explorers!

Our team at Total Mayhem Games has been working relentlessly over the past few months to create [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1341290/view/3899618910154000464]Patch 1.2[/url]. We have incorporated approximately 200 enhancements to enrich your Antarctic adventure and ensure smooth exploring. With the new patch, [b]FPS performance improves significantly[/b] as shown in the image below.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/a89b3c548a42b5009917fc25164f63e9f096dbca.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/a89b3c548a42b5009917fc25164f63e9f096dbca.png[/img][/url]

In addition to these enhancements available to all players, we are happy to announce that [b][i]We Were Here Forever[/i] now supports NVIDIA DLSS![/b] This means that all players with a compatible NVIDIA graphics card now experience a [b]boost of up to 50% in performance and efficiency[/b]. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1341290/view/3899618910154000464]Patch 1.2[/url] just rolled out with the following changes:
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] DLSS support! Turn on DLSS with an eligible NVIDIA video card and enjoy significantly enhanced performance and smoother gameplay, all while maintaining superb image quality.
[*] Texture Streaming enabled! This allows better memory consumption with better loading times.
[*] Reworked Sound FX! Our team has gone through the most noticeable sound effects of the game and a lot of them have been completely reworked.
[*] The Zoom factor of the zoom button has been increased, making it a lot easier to spot something in the distance.
[*] Major Unity Engine Upgrade
[*] Patch 1.2 also offers optimal performance on Steam Deck![/list][h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explorers in the menu are now animated
[*] Localization fixes for:
[list]
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Spanish[/list] [*] Upgraded Environmental effects + SFX
[*] Enhanced sound effects at several areas
[*] Improved lighting, shading, and visuals of many different areas
[*] Reworked the vault door scene
[*] Reworked the entire scene of the ride to the Foundry
[*] Reworked the finale scene of the Illusions area
[*] Reworked the transitioning scene from the Crossroads to the Graveyard
[*] Revised game design of The Reflections
[*] Reworked the activation of the Astrolabe machine in the Bell Tower area
[*] The goal of the Memento area is now enhanced and more clear
[*] Voice chat now keeps working during the intro video
[*] Fixed several issues where players could get stuck and could not progress
[*] Fixed achievement bugs (e.g. Achievement for ‘The Ruins of Rockbury’)
[*] … And much, much, much more! See [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1341290/view/3899618910154000464]Patch Notes 1.2[/url] to get into the nitty-gritty details[/list]
[b]If you still run into trouble while exploring, check out our [url=https://totalmayhemgames.com/support/support-we-were-here-forever/][b]support page[/b][/url][/b]

[b]Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/TxRYRAz][b]Discord community[/b][/url] to share stories of your adventures with other Explorers[/b]

[h2] Winter Wonder Sales [/h2]

You can explore the other games in the [i]We Were Here[/i] series as they join the Steam Winter Sale.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12260/We_Were_Here_Series/

If you want a little extra holiday spirit while playing [i]We Were Here[/i], we advice you to visit the basecamp in [i]We Were Here Together[/i]. Brings you right into the Christmas spirits. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/4922443ce56a70ffba03566fa5f96bf49727d773.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/4922443ce56a70ffba03566fa5f96bf49727d773.png[/img][/url]

Additionally, [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] is also [b]45% off during the Winter Sale[/b]. The perfect opportunity to snatch a last-minute gift for your friends who you've been dying to play the game with. Or maybe you want to annoy them by messing up the puzzles, whatever works for you ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

[h1]Happy Holidays and Happy Exploring[/h1]

Total Mayhem Games!

notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
Our team at Total Mayhem Games has been working relentlessly over the past few months to elevate We Were Here Forever. 

We have just released version 1.2, containing the following changes:

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] DLSS support! Turn on DLSS with an eligible NVIDIA video card and enjoy significantly enhanced performance and smoother gameplay, all while maintaining superb image quality.
[*] Texture Streaming enabled! Texture streaming allows better memory consumption with better loading times. 
[*] Reworked Sound FX! The team has done an extra pass on some of the most noticeable sound effects in the game, and a lot of them have been completely reworked.
[*] Zoom factor of the zoom button has been increased, making it a lot easier to spot something in the distance.
[*] Patch 1.2 has been checked for the Steamdeck for optimal performance!
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[h2]Lobby & Menu[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explorers in the menu are now animated (as originally intended)
[*] Matchmaking - Joining a random room didn’t allow Epic & Steam players to connect
[*] Checkpoint data/selection is not always in sync between clients
[*] Selecting a language is now in alphabetical order
[*] In-game menu doesn’t always scale properly
[/list]
[h2]Overall[/h2]
Localization fixes for: 
[list]
[*] German
[*] French
[*] Spanish

[*] Cobwebs visual improved
[*] Lighting artifact issues
[*] Texture wrapping issue on models
[/list]
[h2]Areas[/h2]
[h3]Intro[/h3]
[list]
[*] Voice chat now keeps working during the intro video
[/list]
[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
[list]
[*] Texture improvements
[*] Several holes in the ceiling
[*] Several lighting issues
[/list]
[h3]The Chasm[/h3]
[list]
[*] Softlock when walking backward through the initial door
[*] Softlock in Pin-puzzle
[*] Timelock puzzle not clearly visible when using torch
[*] ‘Crouch slap’-issue fixed with dial lock puzzle
[*] Holes in the ceiling, walls and around the vault door
[*] The vault door scene reworked
[*] Environmental effects + SFX
[*] Cinema Machine, prerequisites are unclear
[*] Cinema Machine, projections are too low resolution
[*] Cinema Machine, not all wheels are spinning
[*] Elevator audio missing
[*] Gameplay directions when solved the Cinema Machine
[*] Hand animation on capstan
[*] Both capstan directions should work
[*] No sound on cage sequence
[*] Walkie-talkie disappears during dua hold animation
[*] ‘Duplicate key’-effect when opening door with reusable key
[*] Unreadable icons when torch is on
[*] Cage clipping through objects
[/list]
[h3]The Vault[/h3]
[list]
[*] VFX upgrade + performance gain
[*] Massive SFX improvement
[*] Lighting fixes
[*] The projector is already on, despite not being lit by torch
[*] The steering wheel is missing sound
[*] Goals & books are better lit
[/list]
[h3]The Trials[/h3]
[list]
[*] Holes in the layout when player enters the lower section
[*] Floor panels have no audio
[*] After fail, lighting doesn’t always turn back on
[*] Lights sometimes switch off again
[*] Torch SFX plays twice for every torch on the wall
[*] Inconsistency with door audio when progressing to next level
[/list]
[h3]The Memento[/h3]
[list]
[*] The goal of the area is visually unclear / underwhelming
[/list]
[h3]The Illusions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random black overlay appearing
[*] Non-activated platforms are too clearly visible
[*] Reworked the finale scene
[/list]
[h3]The Broken Road[/h3]
[list]
[*] Clipping objects
[*] Texture issues with rocks
[*] Minor SFX issues
[/list]
[h3]The Pledge[/h3]
[list]
[*] Volume fix of SFX
[*] Owl statue animation issues
[*] Floating objects in the backroom
[*] Multiple shadow casters impact performance
[*] Subtitles don’t stop when interrupting automaton
[/list]
[h3]The Chapel[/h3]
[list]
[*] The doors next to the organ missing
[*] Collider issues
[*] Changed order of completion sounds
[*] The organ would give feedback too early
[*] The transition from confession booth isn’t smooth
[*] Several clipping objects
[*] Weird glow element on the barrel (misleading)
[*] Glowing plank on the elevator wall
[/list]
[h3]The Crossroads[/h3]
[list]
[*] Transition to Graveyard reworked scene
[*] Rope textures of cable cart
[*] Upon first arrival, the ravens are not obvious (at end of cinematic)
[*] Pull handle animation clips out of sync
[/list]
[h3]The Graveyard[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lighting, shading and visual improvements
[*] Treasure trail icons have been revised
[*] Coloring improvements through out the scene
[*] Softlock possibility, by an issue in which the pickaxe isn’t interactable when transferring
[*] Vault door key missing animations
[*] Lighting turns on when entering Mausoleum, but is turned off when opening the vault door
[*] Softlock some players get stuck at Graveyard exit, when reloading checkpoint
[*] Player can get stuck during push animation of the lever on entrance Graveyard area
[*] Figure swap, map item is constantly shown during puzzle
[*] Ghosts breaking graves not visible due to animation lock
[*] Players can interact with the 5th key in the Vault door when reloading from checkpoint
[*] Black stain texture issues with snowy rocks
[*] Reworked (visuals + SFX) ravens in scene
[*] Bell sound is underwhelming
[/list]
[h3]The Foundry[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked entire scene of the ride to the Foundry
[*] Submerged, wood clipping
[*] Submerged, missing collider at the end, falling a bit through the floor
[*] Submerged, Fog volume has no topside fading
[*] Submerged, colorcoding pipes over the wall (better visibility)
[*] Power Restored puzzle, double pipe placement issue
[*] The Nautilus, spam spinning the wheel makes symbols unreadable
[*] The Nautilus, cracks in the glass inconsistent and buggy
[*] The Nautilus, volume meter barely visible (through the glass)
[*] The Nautilus, no sound with water through the cracks
[*] The Assembly, duplicate items
[*] The Assembly, Flask dispenser not working
[*] The Assembly, lighting needs improvement for visibility
[*] Missing SFX when putting on helmet
[*] When wearing helment, walkie-talkie light in hand is still visible
[*] Explorer’s fingers clip through the helmet
[*] Interact on helmet not always showing
[*] UI issues when putting on, putting off helmet
[/list]
[h3]The Ruins of Rockbury[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lighting, shading and visual improvements
[*] Softlock during traversal through Rockbury
[*] Transition from the crossroads has been shortened
[*] Missing rock formations on arrival
[*] Rope textures of cable cart
[*] Achievement bug
[*] The Reflections, game design revision needed
[*] The Reflections, improving sounds during puzzle
[*] The Reflections, player below can reach the levers upper area
[*] Issue with sparkling particles in light beam
[*] Icicles don’t have the right material
[*] Player can jump over fences and get stuck
[*] Astrolabe piece duplication and bug following
[*] Water shader issues
[*] Giant lens is hanging on thin ropes
[*] 360 bridge trigger issues
[*] Culling issues moon beam
[*] Exiting the area by boat has no audio
[*] Beam isn’t projected correctly in various scenario’s
[*] Duo lift locking up on double clicking
[/list]
[h3]The Belltower[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing meshes
[*] Portal shader is sometimes broken during final scene
[*] Astrolabe machine activation and transformation doesn’t have sound
[*] Credits
[*] Music credits loops when switching back to the menu
[/list]

[h2]Other technical upgrades[/h2]
Mayor Unity Engine upgrade, for more stability and better performance

notes.title: We Were Here Forever now available on console!
notes.content:
Hello Explorers,

We’re excited to share that your partners on console can now play [i]We Were Here Forever[/i]. And that’s not all! You can join them on their journey at Castle Rock, Rockbury and more with the introduction of cross-play. 

Will your friendship cross beyond your different platforms, or will one of you get betrayed once more? Check out our new trailer:

[previewyoutube=fbG8YCcnRqI;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate the console release, we’re having a sale here on Steam! You can now get [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] with a [b]20% discount[/b], our highest yet. Team up with your partner, no matter what platform they play on, and get to the puzzle solving!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1341290/We_Were_Here_Forever/

To our Explorers who were waiting (not forever thankfully) for the console release, we had a special secret console club and hosted a unique giveaway for custom made [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] consoles! We hope the 2 winners will enjoy playing the game on their brand new Xbox Series X or PlayStation 5.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/f6aae6e55a6242b1386b06889d3d61de3ed8871c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/f6aae6e55a6242b1386b06889d3d61de3ed8871c.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Ask us Anything[/h2]

We’re hosting an AMA on the [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/PS5/]PS5 Reddit[/url] on [b]February 1st at 3pm CET/6am PST/ 8AM CST/ 11PM JST[/b]! Had any questions about the game (series) that you’ve been dying to get an answer for, or just want to ask what our favourite food is? This is your time to ask us! We’re going to give away some extras too. Hope to see you there!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/48bb22a943dc6cbc740de473e88d148e8417aa6f.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/48bb22a943dc6cbc740de473e88d148e8417aa6f.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Explorer, it’s a cold snow globe[/h2]

We still have some limited-edition [i]We Were Here Forever [/i][url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/product/forever-snow-globes]snowglobes[/url] available. Keep in mind that once they’re sold out, they won’t come back to the store, ever. So be sure to grab one now, or regret it [i]Forever[/i]…
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/5b0680fae3811b96b90e3f43afe36836b6ed7d18.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/5b0680fae3811b96b90e3f43afe36836b6ed7d18.png[/img][/url]

[i][h3]Yours Forever,[/h3]
[/i]
[b]Total Mayhem Games[/b]

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.27
notes.content:
Explorers! The team @ Total Mayhem Games is still working very hard to bring you the best experience. We have noticed that some of you have experienced some issues (probably due to some trickery of the Jester), and we are trying to help you out!
We have just released a new patch, already containing the following changes:

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Rare case where Walkie-Talkies would sometimes disappear during animations
[*] Rare case where Astrolabe items would appear or be stuck on places they could be mounted on
[*] Rare case where players could get stuck in the tutorial
[*] Rare case where players could get stuck in Rockbury using the crane
[*] Rare case where players could get stuck using the capstan to enter the Graveyard area
[*] Rare case where the automaton during Story Reconstruction puzzle would perform sound
[*] Rare case where doors would open after solving the puzzle with the Guardian in the Nautilus
[*] Rare case where players could get stuck in the ski lift towards Rockbury
[*] Minor issues with the Statue puzzle in the Warden's Office
[*] Various minor gameplay & visual issues
[/list]

[b]Potential fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Some additional scenario's where players could get stuck on a black screen 
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimization of several areas and cutscenes, to improve performance
[*] New journey menu has been improved with option to mark areas as completed while starting
[*] Some translations have been improved
[*] Crossroads now has different audio tracks, improving feel of the environment
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Added and improved several animations in the game

[/list]

If you still run into any issues, please check out our support page:
https://totalmayhemgames.com/support/support-we-were-here-forever/

For some direct support, reach out to us on our socials or join our Discord server;
https://discord.com/invite/TxRYRAz

All the love from the team @ Total Mayhem Games!

notes.title: Merry Christmas from the Jester!
notes.content:
Do you like advent calendars? Do you like Christmas songs? This video has both, courtesy of the Jester…

[previewyoutube=536j3LBY2oo;full][/previewyoutube]
Every day a new door will open, and you could win prizes - everything from game keys to merch and more are in the calendar. Follow our social media for a chance to win: [url=https://twitter.com/WeWereHereGame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/totalmayhemgames/]Instagram[/url],it’s all good.

[h2]Special Holiday Puzzle in We Were Here Together[/h2]
In [i]We Were Here Together[/i], the explorers are busy bringing a warm and festive mood to their basecamp. A good way to start any rescue mission or castle-ly adventure!

But they need a little assistance getting the lights in the tree turned on… can you help? The event runs until January 5th!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/4922443ce56a70ffba03566fa5f96bf49727d773.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40040727/4922443ce56a70ffba03566fa5f96bf49727d773.png[/img][/url]
[i]The special festive puzzle is available on the PC, PlayStation and Xbox One versions of We Were Here Together until January 5th 2021.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865360/We_Were_Here_Together/

[h2]We Were Here Forever beta and the Explorer Post[/h2]
Don’t forget to [url=https://totalmayhemgames.com/we-were-here-forever-info/]sign up for the Explorer Post![/url] You’ll be the first to read about [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] news, and it’s also the way to get a shot at being part of the beta testing if that’s your jam - just make sure to check that ‘Beta Tests’ box when you’re signing up for the Explorer Post.

[h3]Today’s Mayhem[/h3]
We have a new episode of our podcast Today’s Mayhem - Nena is sharing some Christmas related news and updates, there are [i]We Were Here Forever[/i] sneak peeks, and co-founder & managing director Lucia answers some questions about TMG’s humble beginnings: how do you get to 900 downloads, and did we expect the game to do so well?

[previewyoutube=hF8W5-TQYYU;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Stay warm with TMG gear![/h2]
Our store selection continues to expand with new [url=https://www.totalmayhemmerch.com/category/new]Christmas merch![/url] Whether you’re looking for festive mugs for your hot chocolate, warm sweaters for snowball fights, or a cosy blanket for sitting by the fire, we’ve got you covered!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/b1115d0fe2203d348abb65f589d3a634d395f3dd.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33592243/1231a34c3ae1f6d4934af983a1d24bc86b0f4a72.png[/img]

[h2]Wishing everyone all the best![/h2]
Have a great time, and we hope you’re able to check out the holiday puzzle in [i]We Were Here Together![/i]

[b]Happy Holidays![/b]
